idea-plugin.name: Catalog Browser for Apache Polaris
idea-plugin.description:
Browse Apache Polaris catalogs from the IDE: catalogs, nested namespaces, Iceberg tables and views.

  • Table details: schema with field ids and defaults, partition spec, sort order, properties (secrets masked), snapshot history with branches and tags.
  • Table data: rows read with the Iceberg Java SDK, so deletion vectors and delete files are applied; at any snapshot, branch or tag; with column choice and partition filters; up to 1000 rows, in a tab or an editor tab.
  • Views: schema and SQL per dialect.
  • Read-only: nothing is ever written to Polaris or to storage.
  • Credentials stay in the IDE's password safe; the IDE's certificates and proxy are used.

Connect in Settings | Tools | Polaris Catalog Browser, then open the Polaris tool window.
